reason: A context-management plugin for DeepSeek Harness that compresses and prunes conversation and tool-result content while preserving protected material and providing recovery, commands, and statistics.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供动态上下文压缩、工具结果剪枝、受保护内容保留以及上下文恢复与统计命令。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with dynamic context compression, tool-result pruning, protected-content preservation, and context recovery and statistics commands.

capabilities: Compresses and prunes conversation context and tool results
Adds model-facing compression guidance and context boundary markers
Provides manual context-management commands and statistics
Supports restoration and recompression of compressed context
